scene: The spicy neon cabbage makes your tongue tingle with electric sky-routes.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a stone sky-dock terrace. On the far left, a pink bullet train waits at an open gate. Left of centre, the player stands on roller skates with glowing blue lips. In the centre, a solar-sailed junk ship rocks gently at the railing. On the far right sits a green dragon maglev train.
shown: a sleek pink bullet train idling on glowing rails on the far left
a wooden junk with shimmering solar sails moored in the centre
a carved dragon-headed maglev tram waiting beside a platform on the far right
